name: ccmanager
headline: ccmanager session management for coders
short_description: CCManager is a CLI tool for managing AI coding assistant sessions. It supports Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, and others. Developers can switch between agents, manage sessions, and integrate with IDEs like Cursor and GitHub Copilot.
author: kbwo

sections.overview:
CCManager is a command-line interface designed to streamline the management of AI coding assistant sessions across multiple platforms including Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Codex CLI. Developers can use CCManager to switch between different AI agents, organize and persist sessions, and integrate with IDEs like Cursor. The tool simplifies workflows for teams working with multiple AI coding assistants by centralizing session management in one unified CLI. It addresses the complexity of juggling multiple AI tools by providing a consistent interface for session control and switching.
Manage multiple AI coding assistant sessions across different Git repositories from a single interface.
Copy session data between worktrees to maintain context when switching branches during feature development.
Set up automated notifications for session state changes to stay informed about when input is needed.
Integrate with Devcontainer for a seamless development experience across various environments.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/kbwo/ccmanager`
sections.usage:
```
Initialize a new coding session with [AI_ASSISTANT] for [PROJECT_NAME]. Set the context to [PROJECT_DESCRIPTION]. Ensure the session is compatible with [IDE_NAME] and enable version control integration with [VERSION_CONTROL_SYSTEM].
```
Copy

```
Session initialized successfully with Claude Code for the 'E-commerce Dashboard' project. Context set to: 'A React-based dashboard for tracking sales, inventory, and customer analytics. Uses Redux for state management and Chart.js for data visualization.' Session ID: 4f7a2b1e-3c9d-4f2a-8b3c-1d4e5f6a7b8c. IDE compatibility confirmed for Cursor. Git integration enabled with GitHub. Ready for coding assistance.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
